tabs.tab_title: What is the difference between FirstThought and FirstChoice?
tabs.tab_content: FirstThought gets you found. FirstChoice turns the people who find you into leads and customers. Lots of visibility with weak conversion wastes money, and great conversion with no visibility has nothing to convert.
Something valuable a visitor gets in exchange for their contact details, like a checklist, guide, quiz or free estimate. It captures people who aren’t ready to call yet.

tabs.tab_title: How fast should we respond to new leads?
tabs.tab_content: Within five minutes if you can. The first business to respond usually wins the job, which is why we automate the first reply.
Not when it’s done well. Every message is written in your voice, kept short and handed to a real person when it matters.

tabs.tab_title: Can I hire you for just this stage?
tabs.tab_content: Every partnership covers the full framework, with priorities set around your weakest stage. If FirstChoice is where you’re losing customers, that’s where your plan starts. Prefer to work on it yourself? The FirstChoice module in the BeFirst Community covers it step by step.
